'''09''' was a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] who participated in the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of the Rishi moon]].

==History==
After [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were presumed "pulverized," it and two other droid commandos, Units [[07/Legends|07]] and [[08/Legends|08]] guarded the entrance to the station. When Unit 07 was fooled by Rex using unit 26's head the commando droid opened the [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] to the base it was shot by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] waiting outside.
